prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1027; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the injured party in connection with the parking lot collision described in your insured's claim file. Our client suffered injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability limits and any other applicable coverage available under the policy issued to your insured, along with a written declaration of those limits.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to the collision. This includes photographs, video footage from the parking lot or nearby cameras, vehicle data, witness statements, adjuster notes, recorded calls, repair estimates, and any other documents or electronic records connected with the claim. Please confirm in writing that these materials are being retained and will not be altered or discarded while the claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response.
